subject.title: feat(android): add Wear real-time Talk controls

question: Should OpenClaw accept Wear realtime Talk and the associated Wear release/CI surface as an Android-owned product increment after the companion base lands?
rationale: The implementation adds a new user-facing app mode, release artifact, CI contract, Gateway parameter, and continuous-audio security boundary; code review cannot decide the intended Wear publication and long-term ownership policy.

options.title: Land base, then narrow
options.body: Resolve https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108997 first, rebase this PR to the realtime-only delta, and require Android-owner review of release and security behavior.

options.title: Sponsor combined Wear launch
options.body: Explicitly approve the combined companion, realtime Talk, packaging, and CI scope and review it as one coordinated Android release program.

options.title: Pause realtime expansion
options.body: Keep only the merged phone-proxy foundation until maintainers are ready to own a standalone Wear UI and publication track.

recommendation.title: Land base, then narrow
recommendation.body: Resolve https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108997 first, rebase this PR to the realtime-only delta, and require Android-owner review of release and security behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the documented Android app owner and the decision primarily affects Android/Wear product, packaging, and release ownership.
